Dukatikapaṭṭāna
Bud. Pāli. on causal relationships. from seventh book of Abhidammapiṭaka. IO. Pāli p. 62 (no. 27). Paris Pāli p. 34.
Mentioned in a. ins. d. 1442 A. D. a. Pagan. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 102.
Pt.. Paṭṭhānapāli. Pt. VI. Nālandā Dng. Pāli Ser. p.. 51-70. 1961.

Dukanipātajātaka
Bud. Pāli. section II of Khuddakanikāya.
--C. Aṭṭhakathā by Buddhaghoṣa. Br. Mus. Pāli II. p. 109 (fr.). [Page073-a.
For the text see Jātaka Pt. I. p.. 34-65. Nālandā Dng. Pāli Ser. 1959.

Dukapaṭṭhāna
Bud. Pāli. from Abhidhammapiṭaka. IO. Pāli p. 61 (no. 27). Paris Pāli p. 34 (2 mss.). Providence Pāli 18.
Pt.. Paṭṭhānapāli. Pt. VI. Nālandā Dng. Pāli Ser. p.. 15-50.

Dukūlāharaṇa
kāvya. by Govindaratha; patronised by king of Bāṇapurī (a. of Jagannāthakāvya). MT. 3731 (a. (inc.).
